definitions.gloss: phone photo; phone snapshot; photo sent by phone
definitions.explanation: A photo taken with a mobile phone, especially a casual one shared with friends. Originally short for {写真|しゃしん}メール (photo message), the term still feels somewhat dated and is mostly used by older speakers.

examples.japanese: {写|しゃ}メ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|しゃ}メ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a phone photo of my lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}りたがる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{写|しゃ}メ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: My mother wants to know how her grandchild is doing, so I often send her phone photos.

notes:
Originally short for ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ ("photo mail"), referring to the early-2000s practice of sending photos via cell-phone email. The word peaked around the flip-phone era and now sounds slightly dated — younger speakers are more likely to say ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ or use service names like LINE で⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|しゃ}メ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a phone photo
- {写|しゃ}メ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a phone photo
- {写|しゃ}メる: (verb form) to snap a phone photo

REGISTER:
Casual only. Avoid in formal writing or business contexts, where ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ or ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧ is more appropriate.
